title: Cinder A2UI Catalog
description: Cinder components an agent may place on an A2UI v0.9.1 surface. Offered only to clients that list this catalog's id in supportedCatalogIds.

Checkbox.description: Binary or tri-state selection control with bindable checked and indeterminate state for forms and lists. A2UI 'label' maps from Cinder 'label'.

label.description: Visible label rendered in a `<label>` element associated via `for`. Accessible name (Cinder `label`).

description.description: Helper text displayed below the checkbox; wired via `aria-describedby`.

indeterminate.description: Bound indeterminate state. Mutually exclusive with `checked` visually.

CopyButton.description: Button that writes plain text plus optional rich HTML/image clipboard representations and flips to a confirmation state after success. A2UI 'label' maps from Cinder 'label'.

label.description: Accessible label for the idle state. Defaults to "Copy to clipboard". Accessible name (Cinder `label`).

confirmDuration.description: Duration in ms to show the confirmation state. Default 1500.

copiedLabel.description:
Accessible label for the copied state — what `aria-live="polite"` announces
when the copy succeeds. Defaults to "Copied". Override this when `label` is
customized so the live-region announcement reflects what just happened
(e.g. label="Copy code" + copiedLabel="Code copied").

iconOnly.description:
Render the button with only an icon and a visually hidden label.
When true, defaults to a Copy icon (idle) and a Check icon (copied).

value.description: Text to copy to the clipboard.

Meter.description: Bounded measurement gauge with meter semantics for readings like battery, quota, CPU, and memory utilization. A2UI 'label' maps from Cinder 'ariaLabel'.

label.description:
Accessible name applied directly to the meter element when no visible
label element is present. Accessible name (Cinder `ariaLabel`).

high.description: Upper threshold boundary for segmented rendering.

low.description: Lower threshold boundary for segmented rendering.

max.description: Upper bound for the range. Defaults to 100.

min.description: Lower bound for the range. Defaults to 0.

optimum.description:
Optimal target value. Influences computed state semantics to match native
meter expectations.

size.description: Size token for track height. Default `md`.

NumberInput.description: Numeric input with locale-aware formatting, min and max bounds, and step increments emitting a number or null. A2UI 'label' maps from Cinder 'label'.

adornment.description: Optional non-interactive text rendered before the stepper controls.

Progress.description: Determinate or indeterminate progressbar rendered as a horizontal bar or ring with full ARIA value semantics. A2UI 'label' maps from Cinder 'ariaLabel'.

label.description:
Accessible name applied directly to the progressbar element when no
visible label element is present in the page. Required unless
`ariaLabelledby` is supplied. Accessible name (Cinder `ariaLabel`).

value.description: Current progress value. Omit for indeterminate.

Rating.description: Star rating control with bindable numeric value, optional half-star precision, and a non-interactive readonly display mode. A2UI 'label' maps from Cinder 'label'.

label.description: Visible group label rendered above the rating. Accessible name (Cinder `label`).

count.description:
Number of rating slots. Normalized to an integer in `[1, 10]`; non-finite
or out-of-range values fall back to `5`.

description.description: Optional description text rendered below the rating.

disabled.description: Disable every rating control and the hidden input.

error.description: Optional error message; sets `aria-invalid="true"` on the rating group.

labelVisible.description:
Whether the `label` is visibly rendered. Set `false` to visually hide it
while keeping it programmatically associated.

precision.description: Precision of each step. Defaults to `'whole'`.

readonly.description: Render a non-interactive display with an accessible text equivalent.

required.description: Mark the group as required for assistive technology.

value.description:
Bindable rating value. `0` represents an unrated state. External values
are clamped into `[0, count]` and snapped to the nearest precision step.

**No write-back normalization.** The bound prop reflects exactly what the
consumer set — it is NOT mutated back to the clamped/snapped value. The
displayed and submitted value is normalized via `$derived`, but the binding
itself is left untouched. This is intentional: the consumer owns the source
of truth, and silent mutation of a bound prop is a surprising side-effect.

Spinner.description: Compact role="status" indicator that communicates indeterminate background work with an accessible loading label. A2UI 'label' maps from Cinder 'label'.

Toggle.description: Sliding switch implementing the WAI-ARIA switch pattern for a single on or off setting that applies immediately. A2UI 'label' maps from Cinder 'label'.

label.description: Visible label text. Always the accessible name, even when `labelVisible` is set. Required. Accessible name (Cinder `label`).

checked.description: Whether the toggle is currently checked. Bindable — defaults to false.

disabled.description: Prevents interaction when true. Sets `disabled` attribute.

labelVisible.description:
Whether the label is visibly rendered. Set `false` for icon-only or
inline contexts — it stays the accessible name.

value.description:
Value submitted for the hidden checkbox when `checked` and `name` is set.
Mirrors native checkbox semantics: the pair `name=value` is sent only while
checked. Defaults to `'on'`. Ignored when `name` is unset.

theme.description: Cinder takes no theme from the agent; the host's Cinder theme applies.

anyFunction.description: Cinder declares no client functions, so no function call validates.
